title: Dispur
sub: From Assampedia, the free Assam encyclopedia
body:
Dispur is the capital of Assam. It is a locality within the Guwahati city area, and houses the Assam Secretariat, the Assam Legislative Assembly and other state government offices.

Dispur became the capital in 1973, when Assam's capital moved from Shillong (which became the capital of the new state of Meghalaya).
extra:
Government

Dispur houses the Assam Secretariat (Janata Bhawan), the Legislative Assembly complex and the residences of ministers. Guwahati's municipal area surrounds it, so Dispur functions as a capital locality rather than a separate city.
